notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

For the upcoming new game of Mozg Labs, we created a [b]Steam group[/b] to gather all your feedback about our games but also to share with you interesting news and updates not necessaraly focused on our games, but also on independant developer games, new technologies or other stuff.

[u]We wish to provide a friendly, very active and amusing community[/u] to all the gamers who played once one of our games or want to play them.

[h1]http://steamcommunity.com/groups/mozg_labs[/h1]

The group is [b]Public and open to everyone, so don't hesitate to invite all your friends[/b], you can post and share everything you want in the discussions. We will have a special announcement this Sunday and another one on Monday 23rd.

Join us now ;)

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Here is the patch 1.8 : 

- Planets are now much more balanced (power & frequence of the attacks)
- Balanced weapon firepower (all weapons have been balanced, lasers do a little less damage to shields, accuracy slightly increased (especially for huge weapons))
- Items mass rebalanced
- Enemy's armor rating is reduced
- Autofight speed inscreased

As usual, we took the opportunity to also update the version of the software we are using to code the game, we hope that will solve many compatibility issues (graphic cards, OS, third party softwares...) and improve stability.

Don't hesitate to give us your feedback in the dedicated thread :
http://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/357285398697136691/

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.7 : Bug Hunt !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

There is the patch log for the version 1.7, some of you may have noticed that we released this weekend and yesterday, two very small updates, it was mainly bug fixing and optimisation for the game; here is a more detailed list of the changes we made : 

[h1]Bugfixing[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed mission not removing on aborting
    [*] Drone/Probes using fixed
    [*] Added mouse scrolling on galaxy and stellar maps
    [*] Techs are now properly influence ships
    [*] Fixed research naming in computers
    [*] Fixed formation/strategy persisting
[/list]
We took the opportunity to also update the version of the software we are using, we hope that will solve many compatibility issues (graphic cards, OS, third party softwares (Norton)...)

Want to talk about it :
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/405690850599297523/]Join the discussion here[/url]

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.6 : Expand !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
Here we are, the new update is available on Steam ! Update 1.6 : Expand !

Why "1.6", the last one was 1.4 ?
Nothing important, we update the mobile version accordingly with the PC version, from now, they will share the same version number.

Why "Expand" ?
Because Into the Void is a 4X game : Explore + Expand + Exploit + Exterminate and we needed a little bit more "expand" and "exploit" in the game to be really a XXXX game.

To prepare this "Expand" version we needed you can access all the planets in every mission of the game, it wasn't possible with the previous system, they were all seperated. We did this change in the previous update and it occurs many save problems. In this new update we totally reworked the save system to match the changes.

[h1]Global changes[/h1]
- Loot (including Legendary and Rare items) : you can now scavenge defeated ennemy fleets to find modules !
- Now time can be scrolled from the base
- Rebalancing (because of loot and planets appearing, fewer resources from dismanteling items and fewer resources will be gained from battles, 2nd part of the game made a littile harder ;) )
- Saves now in files and not in the registry : will fix windows bug, but corrupted saves won't be possible to restore)
- Tooltips : it's a first step to make the game more user friendly and easy to begin.

[h1]Expand ![/h1]
- Colonisation : You can now colonise planets !
- Building : You can build on your colonised planets !
- Capturing : Another faction already colonised a planet ? Capture it !


[h1]Bugfixing[/h1]
- With all your feedback in the Discussions on Steam we managed to fix a lot of bugs.
Thank you !

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/451848854985650097/]If you want to discuss about the update join us in the discussion[/url]

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello Leaders,

There is a new update for Into the Void, a first round of new big things coming for Christmas.

[h1]Global changes[/h1]
- Galaxies are now persistent for each act : Galaxies are generated when you start for the first time a mission, if you leave the mission you will have the same galaxy.
- More names for systems/stars (system name = star name)
- Planet names are now binded with the star name
- New Galaxy map backgrounds + optimizations
- Parralax backgrounds

[h1]Battles[/h1]
- Improvement of Autobattle AI

[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]
- Bugfixes (achievements and ending)

To comment this update, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/487876568240820911/]join us in the discussions in Into the Void hub.[/url]

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We updated Into the Void this morning. Here are the changes :)

*Battles*
- Subsystems UI updating : second phase of battle UI improvements, we will continue to polish it with your feedback.

- Battle camera movement improved : There it is, we improved all the camera positionning and totally changed the view during attack. You can now see both ships, the attacker and the defender.

- Autobattle now makes time to run much faster
- Damages and status changes are now displayed correctly above the ships in battle.

*Balancing*
- Enemies rebalancing (ships has more health but less armor)
- Small weapons rebalancing
- Weapons accuracy now doesn't increase on upgrade 
- Some high-level ships became a little more expensive

*Bug fixing*
- Lots of bugfixes
- Game no longer stops on fleet/ship status loosing

*Others*
- Performance updates


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/487876568226286337/]Join the discussions and talk about the patch 1.3 [/url]

notes.title: Into the Void : Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We continue our updates to improve all the aspects of the game, thank you again for all your feedback, we read all your post/comment/tweet about the game even if we don't answer to them. Let's talk about the update!

PATCH INTO THE VOID 1.2 : 
[list]
[*]Ship's subsystems added: You can now focus a specific part of the ennemy ship! Big shields? Destroy the shield generator first to reduce its efficiency. This new aspect is a part of our global plan to make the fights more interesting and intense, more is coming :)

[*]Ship's status changes are being shown on the right of the screen: We erase the annoying popup coming during your travels and replace it with a notification system. If you need more information, just click on it to display the popup.

[*]Planets now have quest name on preview instead of event name
[*]Rockets are now more accurate
[*]Broken armor now calculates correctly
[*]Better enemy queue highlighting
[*]Research preview now contains it's price
[*]AI fixes
[*]Refuel icon is now fixed
[/list]

The patch is available for everybody.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420270/discussions/1/487876474225000319/]Please comment here.[/url]
